sections.heading: Important tips
sections.body:
Operator: Watermark Master is independently operated by an individual developer (hereinafter "we"). Contact email: soratani@126.com.

This agreement applies to your purchase of picture watermarks, picture refinement and related paid functions of this application through the App Store in Mainland China. Please read the product content, actual total price, service period, renewal method and refund conditions before making payment. The current version of **provides automatic renewal subscriptions, fixed-term manual renewals and one-time buyouts. The three types of products are displayed separately and purchased according to the user's active selection and Apple's confirmation results. Purchasing fixed-term or buyout products will not automatically activate continuous deductions.**

**Pre-purchase notice: This App does not provide a refund entry, refund button or refund commitment. One-time buyouts, fixed-term manual renewals and auto-renewal products are non-refundable after a successful purchase. Auto-renewal can only be turned off by you in the App Store; after that, no charge is made for the next period, the current paid period remains valid until it ends, and fees already paid are not refunded. Please verify the plan, term, total price, support scope and renewal method before confirming.**

**Release plan (confirmed):** Mainland China and all overseas countries and regions where the App Store permits sales. This is the planned distribution scope, not a statement that the app has already launched in every region. The current Chinese version is drafted based on mainland China scenarios, and applicable texts and supplementary information required for overseas issuance still need to be verified based on the actual issuance scope.

**Current service model:** The app currently uses a model of "local image processing on the device + Apple transaction services + open-source storage and cloud function services deployed and operated by the operator." In addition to account authentication, the open-source services are used to store client-reported purchase mirrors, last-known expiration status and expiration-reminder tasks; the purchase mirror is not verified by Apple's servers and does not replace on-device App Store entitlement determinations. There is currently no developer-operated cloud works library; account deletion continues to follow the manual email process described in this agreement. These services do not mean the app is offline, nor that the relevant service providers do not process information.

sections.heading: 1. Contract and Product Description
sections.body:
1. We provide access to this Agreement, the "User Agreement" and the "Privacy Policy" before purchasing; for the management of existing continuous subscriptions, please refer to the "Automatic Renewal Service Agreement"; when opening a new automatic renewal product, you must be clearly informed and complete the necessary authorization. Important transaction conditions should be clearly displayed on the purchase page and cannot just be hidden in the agreement.
2. You actively select the product and authorize payment through the Apple purchase confirmation process. After the transaction payment is successful and confirmed, the purchase contract is established and we shall deliver as agreed. If the payment has been deducted but the rights have not been credited, the delivery or refund responsibilities will not be waived due to failed verification.
3. Paid functions, export resolution and format, batch quantity or times, supported devices and versions, network requirements, whether an application account is required, and family sharing conditions should be listed item by item on the product page. Restrictions not expressly disclosed before purchase will not apply after purchase.
4. The specific product description, promotion commitments and special agreements at the time of purchase are important basis for determining the content of the transaction. An explicit commitment cannot be negated by backend configuration, subsequent agreement updates, or "final interpretation rights." When there is a dispute over the content of the contract, it shall be interpreted in accordance with the law and the legitimate rights and interests of consumers shall not be mechanically covered by a certain page.
5. Cloud AI, manual refinement, cloud storage, independent material packages, etc., are included in the delivery scope of the corresponding products only if they are clearly listed as rights and interests at the time of purchase.

sections.heading: 2. Commodity types and rights and interests
sections.body:
1. Fixed-term products: One-time payment corresponds to the monthly or yearly fee, and the fee will not be automatically deducted after expiration. The application calculates a natural month or year based on the effective transaction time returned by Apple on this machine. If the original date does not exist in the target month, the last day of the month is used; the status can be viewed on the application rights page. The cloud stores only a client-reported purchase mirror, which is not used as an independent cloud basis for verifying entitlements.
2. Auto-renewal products: Users actively choose to auto-renew Tabs and monthly/annual products, and purchase them after Apple confirms authorization; subsequent deductions and renewals are handled in accordance with valid authorization and Apple's current applicable procedures. The app continues to identify valid transactions and provides read-only status and Apple's official operation path instructions. No cancellation or refund operation entrance is provided. Selecting other products or switching tabs does not mean that the original subscription has been cancelled.
3. One-time buyout of goods: One-time payment to obtain the rights to use the functions listed at the time of purchase without a fixed expiration date, and no periodic renewal fees are charged. We will not force purchased buyout features to become subscriptions simply because we launch a new version, change the business model, or stop new sales.
4. The buyout does not of course include future independent products, manual services, or features that continue to consume cloud resources that were not committed at the time of purchase; content that has been expressly promised should still be fulfilled. The original interest cannot be withdrawn on the grounds of reclassification after the sale.
5. Buyout does not guarantee that all future devices and operating systems will be permanently compatible. We should truthfully explain the scope of support and maintain it reasonably; when we are unable to perform due to service cessation or other reasons, we will provide remedies in accordance with the law based on the purchase commitment, performance status and reasons. We cannot make a general agreement that "no responsibility will be taken at the end of the life cycle".

sections.heading: 3 Price and Payment
sections.body:
1. Before purchasing, display the currency, the actual total price of the period or the product, the period and the deduction method. When displaying the converted monthly price of an annual payment product, the actual one-time annual fee is clearly displayed to avoid being understood as only paying a monthly fee.
2. If the amount on the app page and the Apple confirmation page are inconsistent, please suspend the purchase first and contact us. The Apple confirmation page is an important basis for payment authorization, but does not relieve us of our liability for mispricing, misleading advertising, or non-performance.
3. This App does not provide free trials, introductory discounts or other promotional pricing. The price displayed in the App and on Apple's confirmation page is the actual total payable; Pro is a paid entitlement, and the free basic features remain available without purchasing Pro.
4. Digital features of the Mainland China App Store covered by this Agreement are billed through Apple in-app purchases. We do not ask for your Apple password, payment password, verification code, or full card information to process purchases or refunds.
5. You can check your order through Apple receipts and purchase history. If we are required to provide credentials or assistance according to law, we will cooperate and will not be exempted from our obligations because of our status as an individual developer.

sections.heading: 4. Delivery and Restoration of Purchases
sections.body:
1. Confirmed valid transactions should be delivered in a timely manner; explain the situation and assist in recovery when there is a short delay, and do not require repeated payments to resolve already paid transaction issues.
2. After changing the device or reinstalling it, you can use the original Apple account you used to purchase it, and verify your rights through the application's "Restore Purchase" portal. Automatic renewals and non-consumable buyouts are restored according to valid transactions; the restoration, account binding and period accounting mechanism of fixed-term non-renewal products must be explained separately before purchase, and Apple’s native restoration does not promise to cover all product types.
3. An app account is different from an Apple Account and is not required to purchase, restore, or use Pro. Purchased entitlements are verified from valid transactions of the Apple Account used for payment and are not exclusively bound to an app account; switching Apple Accounts does not transfer the original purchase. If you choose to sign in, the app may report the transaction identifier, product identifier, purchase time, and last-known expiration or revocation time to the open-source storage and cloud function service associated with that account for optional purchase history and expiry reminders. When reminders are enabled, the account email address may be used to send them. This mirror never grants Pro access and does not provide cloud order migration between app accounts. You may contact support to disable developer reminders or resolve mistaken associations, account changes, or duplicate purchases.
4. Family sharing is only applicable to products that are actually supported and enabled, subject to the product page and Apple configuration, and does not exclude legal sharing allowed by the platform usage rules.
5. Purchasing software features does not convey full rights to all third-party photos, fonts, trademarks or branding materials. We should explain the scope of the license for the materials we provide ourselves and assume corresponding responsibility for the licensing of our own materials.
6. Local query or recovery is temporarily unavailable, which does not necessarily mean that you have not purchased it, nor does it guarantee that you can still use all paid functions at this time. Please check the purchase account, network, and actual transaction status; transactions that have expired, been refunded, or been canceled will not be used as the basis for continuing to grant corresponding rights and interests. Other purchases that are still valid should be verified separately. The recovery scope and period calculation of fixed-term products after reinstallation or replacement still need to be actually verified. The presence of a "Resume Purchase" button cannot be regarded as a successful verification of all scenarios.
7. Deleting an app account does not delete Apple purchase records, automatically cancel renewals, or result in a refund. After signing out or deleting an app account, you may continue using valid entitlements that StoreKit can verify for the original purchasing Apple Account and may restore purchases without signing in; account-specific purchase mirrors, email reminders, and cloud records will no longer be available. We do not make account deletion conditional on subscription expiry, prior cancellation, or waiver of a refund.

sections.heading: 5. Cancellation, renewal, expiration and platform handling
sections.body:
1. This App does not provide subscription cancellation, refund requests, refund forms or any related platform redirects. Auto-renewal can only be turned off by you in the App Store: open iPhone Settings → your Apple Account at the top → Subscriptions → select the corresponding Watermark Master item → Cancel Subscription. Please verify the Apple Account used for the purchase and rely on the cancellation confirmation and expiry time shown by Apple.
2. After auto-renewal is turned off, no charge will be made for the next subscription period; the current paid period remains valid until it ends, and fees already paid are not refunded. Cancellation is not a refund; submitting a refund request does not mean auto-renewal has been turned off, so please verify each separately.
3. A fixed-term manual renewal is not an auto-renewal: it will not charge automatically on expiry and needs no cancellation; if you do not purchase again, the entitlement ends on expiry and fees already paid are not refunded. A one-time buyout has no recurring charge and is not refundable.
4. Uninstalling the app, signing out, clearing local data or deleting your app account will not turn off auto-renewal and will not produce a refund.
5. If duplicate charges or paid-but-not-delivered entitlements occur, you may email soratani@126.com with the order details; we will help verify with Apple. Such assistance is not a refund commitment, and whether a refund is approved is decided by Apple under its rules.
6. Apple's official subscription management page: https://support.apple.com/118428; order issues and refund requests: https://reportaproblem.apple.com/. These addresses are for your own reference and use outside the App; this App does not provide redirects to them.

sections.heading: 6. Post-purchase refund policy and exceptions
sections.body:
**This App does not provide refund capability and makes no refund commitment. Except where Apple approves a refund under its applicable rules or mandatory law provides otherwise, one-time buyouts, fixed-term manual renewals and auto-renewal products are non-refundable after a successful purchase.**

1. We do not accept refund requests based on a change of mind, no longer needing the product, low usage, not having used it, or a change of personal preference, and we do not refund on a pro-rata basis for unused uses or remaining days.
2. The only self-service action for an auto-renewal product is to turn off auto-renewal in the App Store; after that, no further period is charged, and fees already paid for the current period are not refunded.
3. For orders settled through the App Store, if you believe a charge was unauthorized, you may submit a request to Apple at https://reportaproblem.apple.com/; whether it is approved is decided by Apple under its rules. We do not participate in the review, cannot decide on Apple's behalf, and cannot guarantee the outcome.
4. If duplicate charges or paid-but-not-delivered issues occur, you may email soratani@126.com; we will help verify and handle the matter under applicable law. Such assistance is not a refund commitment.
5. After a refund or revocation is validly confirmed, the corresponding entitlement may be terminated or adjusted accordingly, without affecting other valid purchases; refund disputes are handled separately from other valid purchases.
6. The authorization and validity of transactions by minors are determined by law; verification collects only necessary information and is not conditioned on waiving complaints.
7. This section does not exclude rights granted by mandatory provisions of applicable law; apart from that, we do not provide no-reason refunds or pro-rata refunds for the remaining term.

sections.heading: 7. Adjustment, interruption and suspension of operations
sections.body:
1. The core rights and interests during the paid period shall not be substantially reduced by one party. If adjustments are indeed necessary and affect performance of the contract, notice will be given prominently in advance and options such as reasonable substitutions, reasonable remedies, or refunds in accordance with the law will be provided.
2. If it is unavailable for a long time due to our reasons, we should take into account the impact to take repairs, assist in recovery, refund according to law and other remedies; we do not promise to automatically modify the Apple subscription period. Whether third-party faults are exempt is determined according to law, and the user, Apple or the cloud service provider is not always responsible.
3. When voluntarily terminating online trading activities, a prominent announcement must be made on the main business page at least 30 days in advance in accordance with the law, explaining the cessation of sales, existing rights and interests, refunds, data export and contact arrangements; announcements cannot replace the settlement of unfulfilled obligations.
4. The unperformed part of the term service shall be settled in accordance with the law; reasonable efforts shall be made to maintain the use conditions of the delivered local functions for the buyout. If performance cannot continue, the matter will be handled in accordance with the law.

sections.heading: 8. Responsibilities and Disputes
sections.body:
1. Both parties shall bear liability in accordance with the law and their respective faults. Liability for personal injury, property damage caused by intentional or gross negligence, personal information infringement and other non-exempt matters shall not be excluded. There is no upper limit on compensation that is always limited to the amount paid.
2. This agreement shall be governed by the laws of the mainland of the People's Republic of China. You can negotiate, complain to consumer organizations or regulatory authorities, or file a lawsuit with a people's court with jurisdiction according to law; contacting customer service does not constitute a prerequisite for statutory relief.
3. We will prominently notify you of material changes and will not retroactively reduce purchased benefits. Continued use does not automatically constitute agreement to new charges, automatic renewal, or new uses of personal information.

sections.heading: 1. Activation and authorization
sections.body:
1. Automatic renewal means that you actively choose products such as continuous monthly subscription, continuous annual subscription, etc. After confirming the purchase through Apple, you authorize renewal, charging and continuation of benefits in subsequent periods under the valid conditions of that product.
2. Before activation, the purchase page should clearly display the subscription name, paid benefits, cycle length, actual total amount payable per cycle, cancellation method and agreement link. You cannot only display the converted monthly price and hide the annual fee, nor can you use "free" to hide the automatic conversion to paid billing.

sections.heading: Two cycles and deductions
sections.body:
1. Subscriptions are provided according to the monthly, yearly and other cycles confirmed on the purchase page. The start, expiration and next renewal information are based on the valid transaction status and can be checked on the benefits page or Apple subscription management page.
2. Normal renewals are processed in accordance with Apple's current applicable rules and valid authorization. Apple may start billing before the end of the current cycle; deduction attempts, retries, grace periods, and equity status are based on actual transactions, and does not promise that all products will be deducted exactly 24 hours before expiration.
3. To avoid incomplete operations near the deadline, we recommend turning off auto-renewal as early as possible; once turned off, no charge is made for the next period. This recommendation does not limit your legal right to cancel or change at any time.
4. Failure to renew may cause retry or service interruption. We will not charge additional fees for transactions without valid authorization, nor will we charge liquidated damages, handling fees and other unreasonable fees for canceling future renewals.

sections.heading: 3. Free Version and Pro
sections.body:

2. Pro products consist of auto-renewal subscriptions, fixed-term manual renewals and one-time buyouts; the specific entitlements, term and price are subject to the product page at purchase and Apple's confirmation.

The free version can continue to use basic watermark features; availability of any specific feature is subject to what is actually displayed in the App. After auto-renewal is turned off or a term expires, Pro entitlements end according to the applicable product rules and the free basic features are unaffected.

sections.heading: 4. Renewal Reminder and Current Capacity
sections.body:
1. When the app opens the relevant page or re-enters the foreground, and Apple can return to the status, it will locally query and display the expected renewal date, automatic renewal status, and Apple's official operation path instructions; this information is read-only and does not include cancellation or refund application buttons, nor does it jump to the processing page. This is in-app auxiliary information, not a scheduled backend touch; the displayed date is not guaranteed to be equal to the actual start time of deductions. Please go to Apple Subscription Management to check the actual amount in the next period. The current new purchase price cannot be used to replace the existing subscription renewal price.
2. Only when an email service has actually been configured and enabled, the account email address is available and reminders have not been disabled may the developer use the most recent client-reported purchase mirror to send auxiliary expiration reminders to the account email address. Fixed-term and automatic-renewal products are scheduled according to their respective last-known expiration times; one-time buyouts do not generate expiration reminders. An automatic-renewal reminder reflects only the last-known status reported by the client and does not mean that Apple has confirmed the renewal status in real time; actual charges and expiration are governed by Apple's actual transaction records. You may contact customer service to request that developer reminders be disabled.
3. Apple may provide system or email notifications in accordance with its applicable rules, which shall be subject to its actual service; the application does not describe it as being sent by the developer itself, nor is it presumed that any Apple notification is sufficient to replace the operator's reminder obligations.
4. Whether a reminder can reach the user depends on successful synchronization of the purchase mirror, availability of the account email address, the email service configuration and actual delivery. Failed client reports are queued locally for supplementary reporting, and server-side sending failures are retried according to policy, but delivery of every email is not guaranteed. Reminder channels and conspicuity, price and date information, reach and necessary remediation must still be verified before actual issuance; legal obligations are not waived because of purchase mirrors, supplementary-report queues, failure retries or the text of this Agreement.
5. Administration, assistance and applicable legal responsibilities for existing subscriptions remain. Disputes arising from failure to provide appropriate reminders should be verified based on the authorization, reminder and deduction facts and handled in accordance with the law; all risks should not be passed on to the user.
6. Reminders and cancellation instructions should be provided prominently in accordance with the law before accepting the automatic renewal service and before the renewal date, and you cannot only rely on you to review this agreement on your own. This Agreement does not guarantee that every reminder email will actually be delivered, nor does your agreement to this Agreement mean that you waive the right to reminders or simple cancellation.

sections.heading: 1. Pictures and metadata
sections.body:
1. The photos, image sizes, editing parameters, watermark text and materials you actively select are used for previewing, compositing, refining and exporting on the device. Ordinary image processing does not actively upload photos to the developer's business server, nor does it scan or upload the entire gallery in the background. There is no cloud AI, manual refinement, cloud photo albums or public communities for your works.
2. When EXIF ​​reading is turned on, the camera, lens, aperture, shutter, ISO, shooting time and location text already in the file can be read from the selected photo. This is not real-time location of the device. Turning off this option only affects subsequent imports and will not automatically delete the filled-in watermark text; currently, this editing preference may return to default after the application is restarted, and it cannot be described as permanently withdrawing all location processing.
3. We do not extract facial identity features due to color grading of ordinary images, and we do not require users to upload identity documents for basic editing. The photo itself may contain faces, documents, health, children or other sensitive content. Please use it within the scope of your rights.
4. There is no guarantee that all metadata will be cleared from all exported files, please check the name, location, time and image content before sharing. Sending emails or attaching pictures to customer service is another data transmission scenario. Please block irrelevant and sensitive information.
5. Local avatars are only saved in the application sandbox for account display on the device and are not uploaded to account profile services by the avatar function. Picture export will be written to the system album when the user actively saves and obtains the required permissions.

sections.heading: 2. Account Purchase and Customer Service
sections.body:
### Register and log in

Email registration, verification code verification and login are handled by an open-source authentication service deployed and operated by the operator, which runs together with an open-source database on servers located in mainland China. It processes email addresses, necessary authentication information, account identifiers, sessions and secure connection records. Authentication passwords are submitted to the authentication service over an encrypted connection, are not stored in clear text in the app's local data, and should not be submitted to customer service. Registration verification emails are sent by a mail delivery service and involve the recipient email address and the necessary sending records.

Apple sign-in receives the user identifier, name or email address actually authorized by Apple; the identity token is verified by the Apple provider of that authentication service. Whether Apple's hidden email address is available is subject to the actual authorization. The app does not obtain Apple passwords.

Local account data may be stored in SecureStore; sessions of the authentication service are stored in the local storage currently configured by the SDK, and not all session storage can be described as SecureStore encryption. The authentication service still stores account and sign-in security records, and signing out or uninstalling the app will not automatically delete this data.

Basic features, Pro purchases, and purchase restoration are available without an app account, and purchased entitlements are verified from on-device StoreKit transactions. An app account is used only for optional features selected by the user, such as account information, purchase mirrors, expiry-reminder emails, and cloud records. Refusing to sign in or provide non-essential information such as an avatar does not affect purchasing, restoring, or using purchased Pro access. This information is not used to create a cloud photo library or migrate cloud orders.

### Purchase and Equity

Apps use the App Store to query valid purchases, product identification, purchase or expiration time, and refund/revocation status on the device for delivery and restoration of benefits. The fixed period is calculated based on the effective transaction time available on this machine; the cloud purchase mirror is not used to replace on-device entitlement determinations and does not constitute Apple server-side transaction verification.

The purchased rights follow the Apple account used for payment and are not exclusively bound to a certain application account. Apple's transaction and purchase records are managed by Apple; apps do not receive full bank card, Apple password, or payment passwords for in-app purchases. To retain purchase records, calculate or mirror last-known expiration status and send reminders, the application reports the transaction identifier, original transaction identifier, product identifier, purchase time, last-known expiration or revocation time and reporting time to the open-source storage and cloud function service associated with the current application account as a client-reported purchase mirror. When reminders are actually configured and enabled, reminder emails use the email address already associated with the account rather than registering a separate recipient account. You may contact customer service to request that developer reminders be disabled.

### Customer service and deletion request

The customer service portal or account deletion application portal will request the system to open the mail application and prefill the subject; the account deletion draft only includes the application account ID, login method and request instructions known to the machine, and does not include passwords, verification codes, identity tokens or photo attachments. Users still need to check and send it themselves. Opening a draft does not mean that the request has been sent, accepted, or processed.

Customer service emails are received at soratani@126.com; automatic forwarding is not enabled, and other customer service platforms are not connected; account deletion applications use the same receiving channel. Customer service emails and account deletion applications will be reviewed and manually processed by the operator in mainland China. We process the actual receipt of the sending address, a description of the request, and the information necessary to resolve the issue; the external mail provider also processes the mail according to their rules. The manual processing location does not mean that the email service provider's servers or support access are located only in mainland China; their actual locations are determined by the mail provider's terms of service and the actual settings. There is no back-end work order system, automatic SLA timing or deletion receipt service. There is no commitment to query the remote processing progress in the App; confirm the progress and results by replying to emails or contacting us separately. Attachments such as ordinary customer service emails and problem screenshots will be deleted after the problem is resolved; materials involving order receipts, refund disputes or complaints are separately distinguished. There is currently no fixed retention period. The specific retention basis, period and deletion conditions still need to be clarified before release. This cannot be written as a permanent storage commitment. The above deletion rules are for data controllable by the operator, and do not mean that all backups of the email service provider will be deleted at the same time.

### Manually exported data held by the operator

The operator once manually exported user identifiers, email addresses or profile data from the database of the authentication service, and this data is still retained on the operator's own device located in mainland China, without cloud synchronization or backup. It is used to verify user information and is deleted once that use is complete; the exported data corresponding to a user is also erased when an account deletion request is processed. It is a separate copy of personal information held by the operator; it is not a cloud works library, and it is not exempt from the protection and deletion obligations described in this policy merely because the authentication service is operated by the operator.

sections.heading: 3. Diagnosis and version update
sections.body:
1. The official release provides an optional error diagnostics switch, which is off by default. Only after you actively enable it is the open-source logging and error monitoring tool initialized, and general error prompts, feature/operation names and console log output are sent to that tool; photos, watermark text, account information, request content, performance data, screenshots or playbacks are not sent. New reporting stops immediately when the switch is turned off. Diagnostic information processed independently by Apple systems or platforms does not thereby become data collected by developers through that tool.
2. The official release does not enable runtime hot updates, and does not check for or download new application code through that update service while the app is running; version updates are provided only through App Store installation packages. Development builds, engineering previews or build services differ from end-user hot updates and are not a basis for claiming that the app is completely offline.
3. Past development or test versions uploaded records to the logging tool. The backend historical records have not yet been cleared and are currently used for troubleshooting, problem analysis and experience improvement; they are deleted once the issue is handled, with completion of handling as the deletion condition and no fixed number of days. Changing to off by default does not mean these records have been deleted; the actual fields, data scope, storage regions and implementation of cleanup rules for historical records are subject to that tool's backend records and the selected configuration, and the new default-off setting or new configuration limits must not be described retroactively as meaning that historical versions never processed the relevant information.
4. Account authentication and online processing that users actively choose, such as purchases and customer service, still follow the actual services and processing basis. Hot updates remain disabled; if the diagnostic scope is expanded or hot updates are enabled in the future, the specific notice should be updated first, the real data scope and service configuration verified, and necessary authorization completed in accordance with the law, without reusing this version's "not enabled" description.

sections.heading: 4. System permissions and local control
sections.body:
1. Photo selection and reading are used to actively import pictures, materials or avatars, and save permissions are used to write the results into the album. Actual performance depends on the system selector, limited authorization, and release version; denying corresponding permissions will not affect functions that do not require such permissions.
2. Basic functionality does not require address books, microphones, real-time location or ad tracking. When adding new capabilities such as cameras, they should be described one by one in the corresponding functions and requested as needed.
3. Permissions can be adjusted in system settings. After withdrawal, corresponding new visits will be stopped, but previously legally generated local content, system albums, or files actively sent by users to other services will not be automatically cleared.
4. My Account → Account and Local Data → Clear local data and sign out. It will try to delete the local account data and avatar and sign out of the current session. This operation does not clear all image caches, reset all editing preferences, delete app accounts, revoke Apple login authorization, or cancel subscriptions.
5. Temporary image files are managed by the actual caching mechanism of the application and system. Currently, there is no unified one-click image cache clearing entry or guaranteed period. Uninstallation may delete application sandbox content, but SecureStore/Keychain, system backup, photo albums and external services may have different retention mechanisms, and there is no commitment to delete all data upon uninstallation.

sections.heading: 5. Storage location, period and safety
sections.body:
1. Processing of original images, temporary results and local avatars takes place within the local storage used by the device and the app. Account authentication data, purchase mirrors, reminder tasks and delivery records are processed by the open-source storage and cloud function services and databases deployed and operated by the operator; Apple transactions are processed by Apple; customer service emails, registration verification emails and, where enabled, expiration-reminder emails are processed by the respective mail providers. The developer may access necessary information through the administrative permissions of those services or through customer service emails received; this does not exempt us from responsibility for actual processing.
2. The account authentication service and database are deployed and operated by the operator, with servers located in mainland China, and authentication data is in principle stored within that territory. When overseas users use the account service, their email addresses, account identifiers, sessions and security records are transmitted to and stored in mainland China, constituting a cross-border provision to a jurisdiction other than their own; the operator should verify, according to the actual data flows, the recipients (if any), purposes, methods, categories and channels for exercising rights, and implement the applicable cross-border mechanisms and separate consent required by law. Before an overseas user first uses the account service, the app separately notifies them that their email address, account identifier, session and security records will be transmitted to and stored in mainland China, and proceeds only after confirmation is obtained; if confirmation is refused, they may choose not to use the account service, and the basic watermark features will not be affected. The actual processing and backup arrangements of the server hosting provider and the mail delivery provider are described in the section on the actual third-party service list. The open-source logging and error monitoring tool receives general error prompts, feature/operation names and console log output only after the user actively enables optional error diagnostics; its storage region and retention period are determined by the actual configuration and the selected plan; historical test records of that tool have been confirmed to exist, and their actual fields and cleanup status are subject to the backend records and actual configuration. **The facts above are based on the actual configuration; this policy will be updated when the configuration changes.**
3. Local avatars are deleted on a best-effort basis when replaced, when you sign out, or when you explicitly clear local data. Temporary image caches carry no commitment to a fixed period. Attachments such as ordinary customer service emails and problem screenshots are deleted once the issue has been handled; order receipts, refund disputes or complaint materials currently have no fixed retention period, and the actual retention basis, period and deletion conditions must be clarified before release and must not be described as unlimited retention. Backups of the authentication database are generated by the operator locally on the server hosting the database through logical backups, periodically or manually, and are not uploaded to any third-party cloud storage; backup files are retained for 7 days, and copies beyond that period are deleted by the operator on that schedule; the fact that the operator runs the service must not be taken to imply that no other copies exist. The operator has confirmed that user identifiers, email addresses or profile data were manually exported in the past and are retained only on the operator's own device; these exported data are used to verify user information and are deleted once that use is complete; the exported data corresponding to a user is also erased while an account deletion request is processed. The device is located in mainland China, and no cloud synchronization or backup is performed. Backup and log cleanup on the mail provider's side, as well as categories that must be retained by law or for business necessity, such as order receipts, refund disputes and complaints, are handled respectively under the provider's terms and applicable law; except for statutory retention, they are deleted after processing ends. There is no commitment that the client can immediately clear all backups.
4. Within the scope of actual control, we adopt encrypted transmission, credential protection, least privilege, log minimization and third-party administrative access control; we do not place administrative keys for that service, Apple server private keys or other administrative keys in the App; administrative credentials for the authentication service are held only by the operator and used on a least-privilege basis. When a security incident occurs that must be reported or notified under law, we remedy it according to the actual impact and perform the corresponding obligations.

sections.heading: 6. Actual third-party service list
sections.body:
### Apple identity and purchasing services

Purpose: Actual enabled Apple login, App Store transactions, recovery and subscription management; involves actual authorization information provided by Apple and necessary transaction status. Platform payments are processed by Apple. The actual provider is Apple and its affiliates (transactions in mainland China are handled by Apple's affiliate in mainland China), and the processing region, retention period and role are determined by Apple's official policies and the terms applicable in your region. Policy: https://www.apple.com/legal/privacy/szh/.

### Open-source storage and cloud function services

The open-source storage and cloud function services and database deployed and operated by the operator run on servers located in mainland China. They are used for email registration, verification code verification, login, Apple identity token verification, and storage of client-reported purchase mirrors and reminder tasks, involving email addresses, authentication information, account identifiers, sessions, necessary connection/security records, transaction identifiers, product identifiers, purchase times, last-known expiration or revocation times and reminder delivery records. These services are used only as open-source software operated by the operator and do not receive end-user data of this application; the operator bears the responsibility of a personal information processor. Registration verification emails are sent through a mail delivery service selected by the operator, involving the recipient email address and necessary sending records; the actual service provider, processing region and retention period are determined by the actual configuration and the applicable terms. Expiration-reminder emails may use a mail delivery service selected by the operator; the actual provider, processing region, retention period and cross-border arrangements must be additionally disclosed according to the actual configuration before enablement, and no developer expiration reminders are sent while configuration is incomplete. Backups are managed by the operator, and the specific retention period and copy scope are described in the section on storage locations, periods and security.

### Customer service mailbox

The operator uses soratani@126.com to directly receive ordinary customer service emails and account deletion applications, which are handled by the operator in mainland China; automatic forwarding or access to other customer service platforms is not enabled. This involves the sending address, email content and necessary attachments provided by the user. The actual provider, processing region and backup retention period are determined by the actual configuration and the applicable terms and should not be inferred from the mailbox name.

### Open-source logging and error monitoring tool

It is enabled only after you actively turn on "Optional Error Diagnostics", and is used to receive general error prompts, feature/operation names, console log output and necessary version information in order to troubleshoot abnormalities and improve the experience; it does not send photos, watermark text, account information, request content, performance data, screenshots or playbacks. Network connections will allow the service provider to obtain your IP address. This tool is an open-source solution, acts as a processor, and its storage region and retention period are determined by the actual configuration and the selected plan.

### Services not enabled in this official release

Runtime hot updates are not enabled in this release, are not listed as an enabled data recipient in this version, and no region or period is required for services that are not enabled. Historical test uploads and backend records of this tool have been confirmed to exist and have not yet been cleaned; historical records are used for troubleshooting, problem analysis and experience improvement, and are deleted after the issue is handled; the actual data scope, storage regions and implementation of cleanup rules are subject to the backend records and the actual configuration, and the current default-off setting must not be used to presume that historical records do not exist. Other build or test records are verified according to actual conditions; the presence of existing dependency packages in the project does not mean that the official version is collecting user data.

For existing historical records of this tool, the processing role is processor, and the personal information fields involved, regions, and the scope of deletion and copy retention are subject to the backend records and the actual configuration; if your personal information is involved, you may make requests for access or deletion through the contact information listed in this policy. The protection of historical records and necessary assistance in exercising rights remain handled by us according to the actual scope of control and applicable law, and are not terminated by the current default-off setting.

**Expiration reminders use a mail delivery service selected by the operator, and actual enablement depends on the server-side configuration; no developer expiration reminders are sent unless an actual service has been configured and enabled, and services that have not been enabled are not listed as data processing that has occurred. Before enablement, the processing region, retention period and cross-border arrangements must be supplemented according to the actual service provider.** Customer service emails are sent through the email service selected by the user; the operator's actual receipt process is disclosed separately according to the actual service provider and processing conditions.

We will not disclose, sell, rent or commercially exchange your personal information with any third party, and will not use your photos, watermark text or account information for purposes unrelated to this service. Entrusted processing, provision to independent processors, provision to external parties in accordance with the law, and public disclosure are subject to notification, authorization, contract, security and supervision obligations according to the true roles and applicable law, and the use of hosting services does not exempt us from our own responsibilities.

sections.heading: 7. Cross-border and use restrictions
sections.body:
Account authentication data is stored on servers operated by the operator located in mainland China, so authentication processing for users in mainland China is completed within that territory; when overseas users use the account service, the relevant data is transmitted to and stored in mainland China, constituting a cross-border provision outside their own jurisdiction. The operator should verify, according to the actual data flows, the recipients (if any), purposes, methods, categories and channels for exercising rights, and complete the applicable impact assessment, cross-border mechanisms and separate consent required by law; the operator has provided a separate prompt and confirmation before overseas users first use the account service; the cross-border impact assessment, applicable mechanisms and other procedures required by law should still be completed before release; a general privacy policy page must not be treated as proof that the dedicated obligations have been fulfilled. Where the required conditions are not met, this policy cannot be used in place of measures in order to enable the corresponding processing.

Do not use photos, avatars or watermark text for model training, advertising, publicity cases, sales or public works libraries. Any new purposes must be specifically disclosed separately, and the corresponding authorization, which may be refused, must be obtained in accordance with the law.

sections.heading: 8. Your rights and the actual scope of account deletion
sections.body:
1. You have the rights to know, decide, restrict or reject, access, copy, correct, supplement, delete, withdraw consent and cancel your account in accordance with the law. The avatar can be modified in the personal center; the logging tool's optional error diagnosis is turned off by default and can be turned on or off at any time in the personal center. New reports will be stopped after turning it off; for other requests, please contact soratani@126.com. Only the necessary identity information will be verified, and the complete password or verification code will not be requested.
2. **Local clearing is different from account deletion.** "Apply to delete account" in the personal center provides an in-app account deletion application: after submission, a 15-day waiting period begins, during which you may withdraw the application at any time through the same entrance; when the waiting period expires, a scheduled job automatically deletes the app accounts and cascades the deletion of the purchase mirror, reminder tasks and delivery records. After the deletion is completed, no deletion application record that could be associated with that account is retained. This 15-day period is a withdrawal window provided by the operator, not a uniformly applicable statutory period; if applicable law has stricter requirements, such provisions shall apply, and identity verification will not be used to delay requests that should be processed in accordance with the law. If the in-app entrance is unavailable, you may still apply through soratani@126.com, and the same process applies. Verification is limited to the necessary identity information, and no password or verification code is requested. A database deletion cannot be equated to the immediate clearing of all backups or other copies; backup copies are handled according to the retention period and method described in Section 5 (storage location, period and safety).
3. There is currently no ability to automatically revoke Apple sign-in tokens. Users can manage Apple sign-in authorization separately, but removing it does not automatically delete the app accounts or cancel the Apple subscription. This system operation shall not be regarded as the developer completing all deletion obligations.
4. After receiving the actual request, it should be processed in accordance with applicable laws and the complexity of the request and informed of the progress, legal reasons for failure to meet the request, and complaint channels. There is no commitment to an automatic processing time limit that is not supported by operational capabilities. Do not use unreasonable preconditions for deletion based on unexpired subscriptions, giving up refunds or complaints.
5. When confirming deletion, the processed data, categories, period and usage restrictions that need to be temporarily retained according to law or reasonable technical reasons should be stated. "Logout successfully" should not be used as proof of remote deletion. The processing scope of the app accounts, purchase mirrors, reminder tasks, delivery records, the operator's manual export copy, customer service data and the logging tool history records that may involve the user should be verified separately; the export data corresponding to the user should be cleared according to the confirmed arrangement, and other data should be checked to see if they should be deleted in accordance with the law. A single database operation cannot be regarded as all copies having been cleared. After the deletion is executed, the account can no longer sign in to this application, and its purchase mirror and reminder tasks are no longer retained.
6. Apple subscriptions must be managed separately. Applying to delete, clearing local data, signing out and uninstalling will not cancel the subscription and will not produce a refund. The App does not provide buttons for canceling subscriptions, refund applications, or corresponding platform redirects; the personal center and related pages only retain read-only status and official instructions. Auto-renewal can only be turned off in the App Store; after that, no charge is made for the next period, and the current paid period remains valid until it ends. Subscription management: https://support.apple.com/118428; order issues and refund requests: https://reportaproblem.apple.com/.
7. Deleting an app account does not delete transaction records managed by Apple or exported images in your photo album. After deletion, you may continue using valid Pro entitlements verified by StoreKit and restore purchases without signing in; purchase mirrors, reminder tasks, and delivery records associated with the account are deleted under this policy. The restoration scope follows the "Purchase Agreement" and valid transactions of the original purchasing Apple Account.
8. There is currently no complete interface for exporting cloud works or transferring data; you can still request access, copying or other applicable rights enforcement assistance in accordance with the law for the account information we actually process. The absence of an interface does not constitute a reason for rejecting legal requests; only necessary identity information is verified during processing, and the results are fed back in appropriate ways to avoid providing information to unauthorized recipients.

sections.heading: 9. Minors and Policy Updates
sections.body:
This application is not specifically for children. The account registration and login products are planned to be available to users who are over 14 years old, and there are no plans to provide account services to users under the age of 14. Minors should use it under the guidance of guardians. The current client has not yet implemented an age verification or restriction mechanism, and the target age cannot be written to effectively prevent users under the age of 14 from registering; actual restrictions, handling of users under the age of 14 and the necessary guardian mechanism are still matters to be implemented before release. When inappropriate processing is found, stop, delete or take necessary measures in accordance with the law.

Important changes can be announced through static support pages, store descriptions, or new app versions; there are no remote pop-ups or authorization logging servers. When new or separate consent is required by law, a valid choice should be implemented before the new processing is activated and should not be replaced by continued use of generalizations.

Public privacy policy address: https://www.photo-watermark.site/#/privacy. Developer support page: https://www.photo-watermark.site/. The operator confirms that the home page contains customer service contact information. The operator has confirmed that the HTTPS address is normally accessible; it is still necessary to check that the online text is consistent with this version before publishing. It is currently released for the first time, and there is no historical version yet. Links to non-existing historical versions will not be provided. When updating later, the update date should be stated and the actual available version information should be maintained. Static web pages can host public texts, and there is no need to build dynamic business services for this purpose.

This policy is drafted based on services in mainland China. Overseas issuance still needs to be verified separately based on the actual region.

sections.heading: 8. Responsibilities and Disputes
sections.body:

Negotiation is not a prerequisite for other remedies, and it does not compel remote arbitration or exclusive jurisdiction where the developer is located.

sections.heading: Nine Apple platforms and updates
sections.body:

Agreements should be easily accessible within the app. Prominent reminders of major changes in charges, authorizations, and responsibilities; important notifications can be issued using new app versions, static support pages, or store instructions; there are currently no remote announcement pop-ups or forced re-authorization systems. New charges, renewals, or legally required consent matters should be effectively selected before the relevant functions are activated, and continued use will not be used as a general alternative, and vested rights will not be reduced retroactively.
